name: Sandra Timoteo
headline: Vice President & Senior Practice Director, Technology Practice Group
about:
As a Practice Director at Robert Half, I've made my mark in the technology sector as a top producer. I've consistently exceeded sales quotas, managed successful teams, and built profitable client relationships. My results-driven approach coupled with a keen business acumen have been instrumental in increasing company revenue. As a seasoned sales leader, I've not only managed but also motivated teams to consistently achieve and surpass targets. With this wealth of experience and a strong commitment to excellence, I continuously aim to drive Robert Half's growth and success.
